title: Flankers-FAR
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from a flanker word-reading task (Flankers-FAR) collected at the NeuroCognition Laboratory at San Diego State University. Participants viewed four-letter real words and pseudowords flanked by no flanker, identical flankers, or different flankers while EEG was recorded to examine lexical and attentional processing. The dataset includes behavioral responses collected via game controller during stimulus presentation.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room viewing a 24in LCD monitor at 60in distance. They were presented with 90 four-letter real words and 90 four-letter pseudowords in three flanker conditions (no flanker, identical flankers, different flankers), totaling 270 trials. Each trial began with a purple fixation cross (1000ms), followed by a white fixation cross (500ms), then the stimulus (150ms), followed by a blank screen until the participant responded via a game controller.
